leaves.name: bfhClauseIIKronecker
leaves.doc: Bump-Friedberg-Hoffstein, Invent. Math. 102 (1990) 543-618, opening theorem (pp. 543-544), clause (ii), at weight 2 (k = 1) and trivial character: for f a newform of weight 2 and trivial character (Tau Ceti Newform N 2, f.chi = 1), epsilon the sign of the functional equation of the completed L(s, f) at level N (IsFESign, over ZInQ.Literature.completedL), and S a finite set of primes containing the primes dividing N, there is a fundamental discriminant D != 1 (Int.IsFundamentalDiscr, Mathlib) with epsilon D > 0, every p in S split in Q(sqrt D) (two distinct primes of O_K above p, K a quadratic number field containing sqrt D), and L(1, f, chi_D) != 0 where chi_D(n) = (D/n) is the Kronecker symbol (BFHPrinted.kroneckerSym: chi_8(D) at 2, Mathlib's jacobiSym D p at odd p, completely multiplicative) and L(s, f, chi_D) = sum a_n(f) (D/n) n^(-s) is read through its entire continuation (KroneckerCentralValueNeZero)
leaves.flag: unread: BFH 1990 opening theorem clause (ii) read by the theorem-application audit from page images of pp. 543-544 (docs/theorem-application-audit/evidence/theta-upstream.md, INVENTORY.md A025) and found correct clause by clause by the bfh-leaf statement review (eps D > 0, every p in S split in Q(sqrt D), L(k/2, f, chi_D) != 0 in the analytic normalization = L(k, f, chi_D) here, D fundamental, chi_D(n) = (D/n), no CM exclusion, no level condition); not read by this task (no copy on the host). Remaining definitional identification, standard and not a Lean step: Tau Ceti's newform on Gamma_1(N) with trivial nebentypus is the classical newform on Gamma_0(N) (newform-dict proved Tau Ceti Newform = the printed Atkin-Lehner newform with nebentypus chi, isNewform_iff)
leaves.source: Bump-Friedberg-Hoffstein, Invent. Math. 102 (1990) 543-618, opening theorem, clause (ii), weight 2, trivial character, chi_D the Kronecker symbol (bfh-kronecker; read by the theorem-application audit from page images, A025)
